text: Gift. Query from recipient, were they plastic?  The description says crystal, and I hope they aren't reconstituted glass, made in china!?  Pinging seems like glass.

product_metadata.title: Viski Admiral Crystal Whiskey Tumbler Set of 2 - Premium Crystal Clear Liquor Drinking Glass, Classic Lowball Cocktail Glasses Gift Set, 9 Oz
features: BEAUTIFUL CRYSTAL GLASSES FOR WHISKEY LOVERS – Drink in style with these iconic rocks glasses. At the base, facets sliced into pure crystal give these glasses a traditional look, while the smooth rim creates the perfect sip.

PERFECT FOR LOWBALL COCKTAILS AND BOURBON – Large enough to serve as double old fashioned glasses but suitable for neat pours or whiskey on the rocks, this set of crystal cocktail drinkware will be your go-to glasses for daily sipping.

CLASSIC SPARKLING LEAD-FREE CRYSTAL – Celebrate with your favorite bourbon, rum, or rye with these beautiful tumblers. Facets send rays of light glittering into your liquor, and the heavy bottom gives these cocktail glasses that traditional feel.

IMPRESS FRIENDS AND GUESTS WITH ELEGANT GLASSWARE – Give this set of whiskey tumblers as a gift to whiskey lovers, gifts for Father’s day, or groomsmen gifts. Impress visitors by sharing a pour of Scotch in high-quality crystal lowball glasses.

STRIKING VISKI CRYSTAL DESIGN – Viski embodies the high-end beverage experience. From slender champagne flutes to red wine globes, the brand is driven by striking design. Each Viski collection explores a timeless drinkware style.
description: Thinking of entertaining guests, or perhaps a quiet night at home? Either way, these crystal tumblers by Viski will complement your night splendidly. Their pure crystal composition sends thousands of prismatic rays of light glittering throughout the tumbler to give it the fancy look that every entertainer seeks after. These glassware tumblers are designed with a contemporary look which embodies class and sophistication, which means they are perfect for casual and formal events. They give off a very vintage feel which makes them the perfect addition to any wet bar. Their design allows them to match virtually any decanter or other barware that you may use. These drinking glasses are made with pure crystal which give them a very elite look, which will surely catch the eye of your guests when entertaining. With a manifold design, the multi-faceted sides of the tumblers reflect the light brilliantly into your favorite drink. Being able to hold 9 oz. of liquor, these are the perfect sized glasses to hold just the right amount of your favorite scotch or whiskey to keep you and your guests quenched and happy all evening. Not entertaining guests? Then treat yourself to the finer things in life by enjoying your favorite drinks in a fancy glass. These scotch glasses are perfect for kicking back and relaxing at home by the fireplace after a hard days work, or while enjoying a nightcap. No matter the occasion, these drinking glasses are the perfect way to enjoy your favorite drinks with class!
